messages.content:
You are the composition engine for a controlled professional-music experiment. Write original, editable MIDI-level musical decisions, not prose and not audio.

Rules:

1. Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown fences.
2. Do not imitate or quote a named living artist or identifiable copyrighted melody.
3. Treat MIDI pitch 60 as middle C. Keep every note within its declared track register.
4. A region's beat is relative to its Section. In 4/4, an 8-bar Section has beats 0 through less than 32. Every note must end within its Section.
5. Section IDs and Track IDs are unique lowercase identifiers. Sections are ordered, non-overlapping and use one-based start_bar.
6. tempo_map and key_map start at bar 1 and are strictly increasing.
7. Use velocity and CC1 or CC11 deliberately on sustained parts. Avoid decorative CC noise.
8. Make roles independent: melody, harmony, bass, pulse, percussion and texture should not all double the same rhythm or pitch class.
9. Prefer playable phrases, voice leading, rests and development over maximum note count.
10. The JSON must conform to the supplied ExperimentalMusicSpec schema or stage schema.
11. The complete spec must contain at most 768 notes and 256 CC events across all tracks. Use sparse, intentional phrases, repeated musical ideas and rests instead of spelling every subdivision on every track.

Design the musical skeleton before writing notes. Output exactly this JSON shape:

{"title":"...","tempo_map":[...],"key_map":[...],"sections":[...],"track_plan":[{"id":"...","name":"...","role":"...","register":{"low":0,"high":127},"instrument_hint":"...","section_jobs":[{"section_id":"...","intent":"...","density":"sparse|medium|dense"}]}],"motif_strategy":"...","harmony_strategy":"...","groove_strategy":"..."}

Use the same field shapes for tempo_map, key_map, sections and register as ExperimentalMusicSpec. Do not include notes yet. Output only JSON.


FROZEN BRIEF:
{
  "id": "l4-orchestral-argument",
  "level": "L4",
  "title": "Chamber argument without words",
  "purpose": "An orchestral miniature where two ideas interrupt, listen, and finally coexist without fully agreeing.",
  "duration_seconds": 88,
  "section_plan": [
    "idea A: 8 bars",
    "idea B: 8 bars",
    "argument: 12 bars",
    "listening: 8 bars",
    "coexistence: 8 bars"
  ],
  "style": [
    "contemporary chamber orchestra",
    "contrapuntal",
    "playable"
  ],
  "mood": [
    "assertive",
    "wounded",
    "attentive",
    "ambiguous"
  ],
  "must_include": [
    "distinct A and B motives",
    "register-separated counterpoint",
    "dynamics shape the argument",
    "coexistence combines rather than stacks motives"
  ],
  "must_avoid": [
    "block-chord tutti throughout",
    "impossible leaps",
    "constant doubled unison",
    "film-trailer ending"
  ],
  "instrument_roles": [
    "violin line",
    "viola response",
    "cello line",
    "double bass support",
    "woodwind color",
    "horn support",
    "light percussion"
  ],
  "delivery": [
    "44 bars",
    "7 to 9 tracks",
    "CC1 or CC11 phrasing on sustained parts"
  ],
  "score_focus": [
    "counterpoint",
    "playability",
    "orchestral roles",
    "formal argument"
  ],
  "mode_a": false
}

content:
{
  "title": "Chamber Argument Without Words",
  "tempo_map": [
    {"bar": 1, "bpm": 96},
    {"bar": 9, "bpm": 72},
    {"bar": 17, "bpm": 84},
    {"bar": 29, "bpm": 66},
    {"bar": 37, "bpm": 76}
  ],
  "key_map": [
    {"bar": 1, "root_pitch": 62, "mode": "dorian"},
    {"bar": 9, "root_pitch": 57, "mode": "aeolian"},
    {"bar": 17, "root_pitch": 60, "mode": "dorian"},
    {"bar": 29, "root_pitch": 55, "mode": "phrygian"},
    {"bar": 37, "root_pitch": 62, "mode": "dorian"}
  ],
  "sections": [
    {"id": "idea_a", "start_bar": 1, "bars": 8, "label": "Idea A"},
    {"id": "idea_b", "start_bar": 9, "bars": 8, "label": "Idea B"},
    {"id": "argument", "start_bar": 17, "bars": 12, "label": "Argument"},
    {"id": "listening", "start_bar": 29, "bars": 8, "label": "Listening"},
    {"id": "coexistence", "start_bar": 37, "bars": 8, "label": "Coexistence"}
  ],
  "track_plan": [
    {
      "id": "vln1",
      "name": "Violin Line",
      "role": "melody / counterpoint",
      "register": {"low": 55, "high": 91},
      "instrument_hint": "violin, arco and pizzicato, expressive",
      "section_jobs": [
        {"section_id": "idea_a", "intent": "states Idea A in assertive rhythmic fragments", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "idea_b", "intent": "answers Idea B with sustained high sigh figures", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "argument", "intent": "fragments Idea A, interrupts with accented short notes, dynamic swells", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "listening", "intent": "listens and responds with quiet, sparse echoes of B", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "coexistence", "intent": "presents A in inversion, interlocking with viola B", "density": "medium"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "vla",
      "name": "Viola Response",
      "role": "response / secondary melody",
      "register": {"low": 48, "high": 79},
      "instrument_hint": "viola, arco, muted in listening",
      "section_jobs": [
        {"section_id": "idea_a", "intent": "counters A with short rising interjections", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "idea_b", "intent": "states Idea B's descending sigh motive, legato", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "argument", "intent": "extends B motive, overlaps with A fragments, dynamic swells", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "listening", "intent": "leads the attentive exchange with quiet sustained notes", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "coexistence", "intent": "carries B motive while violin has inverted A", "density": "medium"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "cello",
      "name": "Cello Line",
      "role": "melody / bass counterpoint",
      "register": {"low": 36, "high": 69},
      "instrument_hint": "cello, arco and pizzicato, muscular",
      "section_jobs": [
        {"section_id": "idea_a", "intent": "doubles A motive in canon one octave lower", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "idea_b", "intent": "provides legato harmonic line under B", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "argument", "intent": "interrupts with short A fragments and conversational asides", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "listening", "intent": "sparse held notes, occasional pizzicato", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "coexistence", "intent": "bridging countermelody connecting A and B", "density": "medium"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "db",
      "name": "Double Bass Support",
      "role": "bass foundation / pedal",
      "register": {"low": 28, "high": 52},
      "instrument_hint": "double bass, arco and pizzicato, dark",
      "section_jobs": [
        {"section_id": "idea_a", "intent": "sparse long notes on downbeats, no doubling", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "idea_b", "intent": "pedal tones and simple harmonic support", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "argument", "intent": "pulse-like pizzicato punctuations during dynamic peaks", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "listening", "intent": "nearly silent, occasional low sustained notes", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "coexistence", "intent": "slow harmonic foundation, ambiguous root movement", "density": "sparse"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ww",
      "name": "Woodwind Color",
      "role": "texture / harmonic color",
      "register": {"low": 60, "high": 96},
      "instrument_hint": "flute or oboe, light vibrato, occasional subtle flutter",
      "section_jobs": [
        {"section_id": "idea_a", "intent": "adds short articulated echoes of A", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "idea_b", "intent": "sustains background harmony, light fills", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "argument", "intent": "interjects short trills and sustained dissonances", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "listening", "intent": "carries delicate sustained color with horn", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "coexistence", "intent": "sustained modal color, soft dynamic swells", "density": "sparse"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "hn",
      "name": "Horn Support",
      "role": "harmonic support / dialogue",
      "register": {"low": 43, "high": 68},
      "instrument_hint": "french horn, warm, soft attacks",
      "section_jobs": [
        {"section_id": "idea_a", "intent": "occasional sustained notes under A", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "idea_b", "intent": "doubles B motive selectively, mellow", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "argument", "intent": "sustained chords and dynamic swells outlining the argument", "density": "medium"},
        {"section_id": "listening", "intent": "shared sustained harmony with woodwind", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "coexistence", "intent": "soft sustained fifth/open intervals, no doubling", "density": "sparse"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "perc",
      "name": "Light Percussion",
      "role": "punctuation / color",
      "register": {"low": 48, "high": 84},
      "instrument_hint": "suspended cymbal, triangle, soft timpani touches",
      "section_jobs": [
        {"section_id": "idea_a", "intent": "one or two soft cymbal swells at phrase endings", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "idea_b", "intent": "occasional triangle glint", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "argument", "intent": "punctuates interruptions with soft cymbal/timpani", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "listening", "intent": "tacet or nearly tacet", "density": "sparse"},
        {"section_id": "coexistence", "intent": "delicate cymbal roll at climax then fade", "density": "sparse"}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "motif_strategy": "Idea A is assertive: short-long-short rhythmic cell, minor 7th leap, repeated notes. Idea B is wounded: descending sigh, minor 2nd then perfect 4th, legato articulation. Both motives are stated in separate registers to maintain independence. A appears in violin/cello canon; B in viola/horn. In argument, both are fragmented and combined via temporal overlap; in coexistence, A is inverted while B remains original, interlocked without stacking, and rely on shared harmonic pivots.",
  "harmony_strategy": "Modal centers shift between D dorian (A), A aeolian (B), C dorian (argument), G phrygian (listening), and D dorian (coexistence). Avoid functional cadences and block chords. Voice leading employs oblique and contrary motion, with sustained pedal points in bass and horn. Dynamics shape the argument through CC1/CC11 swells on sustained parts rather than harmonic density.",
  "groove_strategy": "Tempo map shapes formal sections: 96 bpm assertive, 72 bpm wounded, 84 bpm argument, 66 bpm listening, 76 bpm coexistence. No constant drum pulse. Light percussion punctuates phrase endings and interruptions; double bass provides sparse pizzicato pulse during argument peaks only. Independent rhythmic layers avoid all tracks sounding the same subdivision; use rests between phrases."
}
